home.seedBibleBody: Utilize and extend our open platform instead of starting from scratch.
home.compareCaption: What the Free Use Bible API and three widely used Bible APIs let you do

ours.permission: Nothing to accept. AO Lab adds no restrictions; each text keeps its own notice
ours.storage: Cache, store and download without expiry

apiBible.permission: Accept API.Bible’s terms; commercial use adds a licence for each translation
apiBible.storage: Cache allowed, but must refresh at least every 30 days
apiBible.openSource: Client SDKs are open source; the API itself is not

youVersion.permission: Accept the platform terms, then a publisher agreement for each set of translations
youVersion.storage: Set by each publisher agreement; some allow in-app offline use, some limit how much is shown at once
youVersion.openSource: Client SDKs are open source; the API itself is not

bibleBrain.account: Key required, granted at their discretion
bibleBrain.usage: None published, and access can be limited or revoked at any time
bibleBrain.permission: Accept the licence; keys are approved at their discretion
bibleBrain.storage: Offline use only via their download endpoint

home.storageNote: *Copy and store on your own hardware, servers, or on a device so it works offline.
home.contributeBody: Let’s create an open ecosystem of public domain content and open source tools.
